own_solution.law: Archimedes' principle and vertical force balance give T = Fb - mg = (rho_l - rho_s) g a^3. With a = 0.10 m, T = (1000 - 600)(9.8)(0.10)^3 = 3.92 N.
assumptions: The liquid is hydrostatic and has uniform density.
The cube remains at rest and completely submerged without contacting the tank.
The light, taut, vertical string pulls downward.
Lengths are converted to metres when used with SI densities and gravitational acceleration.
